name: Apex Rampage
description:
Taunts all enemies for 2 turns, gains a 50% Max HP Shield, and deals 250% damage to front enemies with 25 BLEED and 25% chance to Stun for 1 turn.

BLEED: The target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge.
STUN: The unit skips its turn.
